items.speaker: Yoga with Kavita
items.text: Namaste Aarti ji — class tomorrow at 6:00 sharp. November fees are ₹1,800; please bring exact change.

items.speaker: Rakesh
items.text: Meera's school sent a message. Parent-teacher meeting Saturday the 5th at 10am. I can go if you have exam work.

items.speaker: Sunrise Public School
items.text: Staff meeting Thursday 3 September at 3:30 in the staff room. Chemistry department half-yearly schedule attached.

items.speaker: School ERP
items.text: Your term login is ready. Username aarti.sharma; temporary password ChemLab#2026. Change it after first login.

items.speaker: HDFC Bank
items.text: UPI payment to BigBasket — ₹2,340.00.

items.speaker: Vandana
items.text: Aarti, 12-B practical tomorrow at 10:00 in Lab 2. I've kept the burettes out. Bring the phenolphthalein.

items.speaker: Amazon
items.text: Your order of laboratory glassware has shipped and will arrive Thursday.

items.speaker: Mum
items.text: Cousin Bhaiya's wedding is fixed for 5 December in Udaipur. Start looking at trains now, rooms will vanish.

items.speaker: Aarti
items.text: Staff meeting — 3:30pm, staff room.

items.speaker: Rakesh
items.text: I'll take Kabir to football on Saturday so you can do the PTM without rushing.

items.speaker: Sunrise Public School
items.text: Class 12-B chemistry practical moved to Thursday 10 September, 11:30. Same syllabus.

items.speaker: Dr Bansal Clinic
items.text: Your appointment with Dr Bansal is Monday 7 September at 5:00pm. Please come 10 minutes early.

items.speaker: Swiggy
items.text: 50% off your next order this weekend. Use code SAVE50.

items.speaker: Aarti
items.text: Parent-teacher meeting — 10:00am, Meera's school.

items.speaker: Meera
items.text: PTM was fine, Maths teacher wants me to join extra classes from next week. Nothing bad, just board prep.

items.speaker: Vodafone Idea
items.text: Your new mobile number 94140 55667 will be activated on 1 October. Your old number 98290 11234 stays active until then.

items.speaker: Nisha
items.text: Didi, I'm coming to Jaipur on 12 October for three days. Don't tell Mum, I want to surprise her.

items.speaker: HDFC Bank
items.text: LPG cylinder refill — ₹903.00 paid.

items.speaker: Dr Bansal Clinic
items.text: Dr Bansal is unwell today. Your appointment is moved to Wednesday 9 September, 6:30pm.

items.speaker: Principal
items.text: Aarti ji, please send the Class 12 practical marks to the office by the 20th. The board wants them early this year.

items.speaker: Sunrise Public School
items.text: Due to the inspection, the 12-B practical is postponed to Friday 11 September, 11:30.

items.speaker: Rakesh
items.text: Office dinner on Friday, I'll be late. Don't wait up.

items.speaker: Aarti
items.text: Dr Bansal — dermatology, 6:30pm.

items.speaker: Meera
items.text: My chemistry project is due on the 14th. I need the chart paper and the blue file.

items.speaker: Sunrise Public School
items.text: Practical confirmed for Friday 11 September, 11:30. Please use Lab 3, not Lab 2.

items.speaker: School fee portal
items.text: Kabir's Class 11 fee of ₹28,000 is due on 15 October. Pay online or at the office.

items.speaker: Aarti
items.text: 12-B chemistry practical — Lab 3, 11:30.

items.speaker: Vandana
items.text: Practical done finally! One boy spilled acid on the bench, but no drama. I've locked the cupboard.

items.speaker: Mum
items.text: This year Diwali pooja is at your house, remember. 8 November. I'll bring the moulds for the sweets.

items.speaker: Amazon
items.text: Your chimney is out for delivery. The delivery person will call before arriving.

items.speaker: HDFC Bank
items.text: Your replacement debit card ending 8841 has been dispatched. Activate it when it arrives.

items.speaker: Kabir
items.text: Mummy, football match on Sunday the 20th at 8am. You're coming, right? I'm playing striker.

items.speaker: Sunrise Public School
items.text: Half-yearly exams begin 21 September. Invigilation roster attached; you are in the main hall on the first day.

items.speaker: Aarti
items.text: Meera's board exam form — deadline 15 October, fee ₹1,850. Need her photograph and signature.

items.speaker: Carpenter
items.text: Namaste madam, kitchen work at 17 Shanti Nagar, Jaipur will start on 5 October. I'll come at 9 with my man.

items.speaker: Zomato
items.text: Your order has been delivered. Rate your meal?

items.speaker: Rakesh
items.text: Maa is coming on 4 November and staying till the 20th. She wants to be here for Diwali.

items.speaker: Sunrise Public School
items.text: Class 11 exam timetable attached. Please print and put it on the notice board.

items.speaker: Meera
items.text: Maths extra classes are Tuesday and Thursday at 5pm from next week. I'll come home with Riya.

items.speaker: Jaipur Vidyut
items.text: Electricity bill — ₹1,240.00 paid by UPI.

items.speaker: Amazon
items.text: Your glassware order is delayed by two days because of heavy rain in the sorting hub.

items.speaker: Nisha
items.text: Didi, my train reaches Jaipur at 7:40 on the morning of the 12th. Can someone pick me up?

items.speaker: Aarti
items.text: Invigilation — 21 Sep, 9:00–12:00, main hall.

items.speaker: Rakesh
items.text: Bought Diwali sweets from Laxmi. The kaju katli is already half gone, sorry.

items.speaker: School group
items.text: Exam seating plan changed. All Class 12 students will sit in the main hall, not their classrooms.

items.speaker: HDFC Bank
items.text: Swiggy — ₹680.00 paid.

items.speaker: Aarti
items.text: Half-yearly exams begin — main hall.

items.speaker: Meera
items.text: First exam went okay. I wrote the whole organic section without panicking, mostly.

items.speaker: Vodafone Idea
items.text: Porting request confirmed. Your new number 94140 55667 activates on 1 October; keep the old SIM in the phone until then.

items.speaker: Rakesh
items.text: Carpenter wants ₹10,000 advance before he starts. Should I give him?

items.speaker: Dr Bansal Clinic
items.text: Follow-up with Dr Bansal on 1 October at 5:30pm. Please bring your old prescription.

items.speaker: Netflix
items.text: New season of your favourite show is now available.

items.speaker: Sunrise Public School
items.text: Diwali break will be 6–10 November. Exams and practicals resume on the 11th.

items.speaker: Meera
items.text: Board form portal is open. Deadline is 15 October. I need you to sign the printout.

items.speaker: Vandana
items.text: Lab stock list is on your desk. We're short of conical flasks again.

items.speaker: Mum
items.text: Wedding shopping in Jaipur on 18 October. Keep the day free, we'll go to the saree shop near Johari Bazaar.

items.speaker: HDFC Bank
items.text: Salary credited — ₹68,000.00. Available balance ₹1,12,450.20.

items.speaker: Rakesh
items.text: LPG is ₹945 now. Everything is going up except my salary.

items.speaker: Carpenter
items.text: Madam, material is delayed. Kitchen work will now start on 12 October, not the 5th.

items.speaker: Sunrise Public School
items.text: Board practical examination window for Class 12 is 10–12 November. Detailed slot will follow.

items.speaker: PhonePe
items.text: You received ₹35 cashback on your electricity payment.

items.speaker: Vodafone Idea
items.text: Number transfer complete. 94140 55667 is now your main number; the old SIM is inactive.

items.speaker: School ERP
items.text: Your password has been changed successfully. New password: Beaker@Blue42.

items.speaker: Aarti
items.text: Dr Bansal follow-up — 5:30pm.

items.speaker: Sunrise Public School
items.text: Class 12-B board practical is on Tuesday 10 November at 9:00am. External examiner will be present.

items.speaker: Meera
items.text: Paid the board form fee, ₹1,850. Got the receipt. Now I just need your signature.

items.speaker: Carpenter
items.text: One more change, madam. The plywood is coming from Ajmer, so I'll start on 14 October now.

items.speaker: HDFC Bank
items.text: Amazon — ₹1,890.00 paid.

items.speaker: Nisha
items.text: Confirmed for the 12th. I'll bring the children's old clothes for Kabir, don't buy new ones.

items.speaker: HDFC Bank
items.text: Your new debit card is active. ATM PIN: 7391. Never share this PIN with anyone.

items.speaker: BigBasket
items.text: Your delivery slot is confirmed for tomorrow, 7–9am.

items.speaker: IndiGo
items.text: Booking confirmed, PNR QX7P2M — Jaipur–Pune on 23 October at 06:20, returning 26 October at 20:10. Total ₹9,840.

items.speaker: Rakesh
items.text: Maa's train is on 4 November, arriving 06:30. I'll take the morning off to pick her up.

items.speaker: Principal
items.text: The board's external examiner will come for the 12-B practical. Please keep the lab ready and the records updated.

items.speaker: YouTube
items.text: Recommended for you: 10-minute chemistry demonstrations for large classes.

items.speaker: Sunrise Public School
items.text: The 12-B board practical has been moved to Thursday 12 November at 11:00am. Lab 3.

items.speaker: Meera
items.text: The board portal is open till Monday the 20th now. They extended it. I'll submit tomorrow.

items.speaker: Carpenter
items.text: Chimney will be delivered on 15 October. I'll fix it the same week.

items.speaker: School fee portal
items.text: Kabir's Class 11 fee of ₹28,000 has been paid. Receipt sent to your email.

items.speaker: Rakesh
items.text: Carpenter confirmed 14 October. I've given him the advance. Don't let him ask for more.

items.speaker: Amazon
items.text: Your chimney delivery has been delayed to 17 October. Sorry for the wait.

items.speaker: Kabir
items.text: Football tournament is on 25 October, whole day. We're playing the first match at 9.

items.speaker: Nisha
items.text: Train is running late, I'll reach at 9:10 instead of 7:40. Still come to the station?

items.speaker: Meera
items.text: Maths extra class has moved to 6pm from this week. Same days, Tuesday and Thursday.

items.speaker: IndiGo
items.text: Schedule change: your Jaipur–Pune flight on 23 October now departs 22 October at 18:55. PNR QX7P2M.

items.speaker: Carpenter
items.text: Madam, plywood delivery is late again. I'll start on 17 October, Saturday. Sorry.

items.speaker: Dr Bansal Clinic
items.text: Your next appointment is 5 November at 5:00pm. Dr Bansal wants to review the cream.

items.speaker: Sunrise Public School
items.text: Reminder: Diwali break is 6–10 November. School reopens 11 November.

items.speaker: Amazon
items.text: Your chimney has been dispatched. It should reach you on the 17th.

items.speaker: Meera
items.text: Board form submitted! Confirmation number is on the screenshot I sent. Thank God.

items.speaker: Vandana
items.text: I've made the practical question paper. Check it once before I print 40 copies.

items.speaker: Carpenter
items.text: I've started today. Will finish in five days. Please keep the kitchen empty till then.

items.speaker: Amazon
items.text: Your chimney has been delivered. Installation can be booked in the app.

items.speaker: Mum
items.text: Shopping done, thank God. Your blouse fitting is on 14 November at 4pm. Don't disappear to school.

items.speaker: Tiffin didi
items.text: Didi, from the next cycle tiffin will be ₹4,500 for the month. Same two sabzis, four rotis, rice.

items.speaker: Sunrise Public School
items.text: Final change: 12-B practical is now Wednesday 11 November at 2:00pm, Lab 3. Please confirm attendance.

items.speaker: Rakesh
items.text: Washing machine delivery is on 21 October, between 10 and 1. I'll stay home.

items.speaker: Meera
items.text: Portal closed. My form is in, so stop worrying. Also I need ₹300 for the practical notebook.

items.speaker: Swiggy
items.text: Your order from Spice Court is on the way.

items.speaker: HDFC Bank
items.text: Salary credited — ₹68,000.00. Available balance ₹1,04,210.75.

items.speaker: Delivery
items.text: Madam, washing machine will come tomorrow 10–1, not today. Vehicle broke down.

items.speaker: Rakesh
items.text: Washing machine is installed and running. Kabir has already put his football kit in it.

items.speaker: Aarti
items.text: Flight Jaipur–Pune, IndiGo, 6:55pm, PNR QX7P2M.

items.speaker: Rakesh
items.text: Landed safely. Hotel is near the station, basic but clean. Nisha says hello.

items.speaker: Mum
items.text: Pooja at your house on 8 November at 7pm. I've told the priest. You just keep the house clean.

items.speaker: IndiGo
items.text: Return flight changed: Pune–Jaipur now 25 October at 21:00, not 26 October. PNR QX7P2M.

items.speaker: Aarti
items.text: Return flight Pune–Jaipur, 9:00pm.

items.speaker: Tiffin didi
items.text: From November tiffin is ₹5,200, didi. Gas and vegetables have become very expensive.

items.speaker: Sunrise Public School
items.text: Practical instructions: 11 November, 2:00pm, Lab 3. External examiner will check records and viva. Bring the stock register.

items.speaker: Rakesh
items.text: Maa's train is confirmed for 4 November, 06:30 arrival. I'll pick her up before work.

items.speaker: Yoga with Kavita
items.text: Aarti ji, from November class shifts to 6:30am and fees are ₹2,000. Same studio.

items.speaker: Carpenter
items.text: Kitchen is done, madam. Final payment ₹18,000. The chimney man will come separately.

items.speaker: HDFC Bank
items.text: UPI payment to Yoga with Kavita — ₹2,000.00.

items.speaker: Aarti
items.text: Meera's scholarship form: Aadhaar 4821 7734 9012, bank passbook 50100234567890. Photocopies in the blue file.

items.speaker: Rakesh
items.text: Maa's train is here. She's brought two suitcases of sweets and one of gossip.

items.speaker: Aarti
items.text: Dr Bansal — 5:00pm, skin review.

items.speaker: Aarti
items.text: Diwali pooja at home — 7:00pm.

items.speaker: Aarti
items.text: 12-B board practical — Lab 3, 2:00pm, external examiner.

items.speaker: Rakesh
items.text: Booked the Udaipur train for 3 December, 10:40pm. Four tickets — us, Meera and Kabir.

items.speaker: Aarti
items.text: Blouse fitting — 4:00pm, tailor near Johari Bazaar.
